Description: Make the live-money path correct and safe: atomic stock, idempotent webhooks, abandoned-order cleanup, order emails.
Finish customer account flows: email verification, password reset, address management UI.
Discount codes: admin management and checkout application.
Shipment tracking and shipping-cost model.
Image/file uploads, homepage banners, product/article tags.
Reviews on product pages, verified-purchase, moderation, wishlist UI.
The differentiator: read-only storefront chatbot and write-enabled admin assistant via Claude tool-use, with chat persistence.
Analytics dashboard, admin-user & role management, site settings, audit log.
Cross-cutting: tests, security baseline, observability, migration hygiene, CI/CD.

Summary: A1: Atomic stock decrement on payment
Description:
As a customer, I want my purchase to decrement stock atomically so the store never oversells.

Acceptance criteria:
- Stock decrement happens within the markAsPaid DB transaction.
- Concurrent checkouts cannot drive variant stock negative (conditional UPDATE ... WHERE stock >= qty or row lock).
- Covered by automated tests simulating concurrency.

Summary: A2: Stripe webhook idempotency & failure handling
Description:
As the business, I want webhooks processed idempotently and failures handled so order state always matches Stripe.

Acceptance criteria:
- Duplicate payment_intent.succeeded events are no-ops (processed-event guard).
- payment_intent.payment_failed / canceled updates or cancels the order.
- Signature verification preserved (raw body).

As the business, I want stale pending_payment orders auto-expired so they don't accumulate or lock stock.

Acceptance criteria:
- Scheduled job cancels/expires orders older than N minutes.
- Any reserved stock is released.

As a customer, I want an order-confirmation email so I have proof of purchase.

Acceptance criteria:
- Email sent when order transitions to paid.
- Includes order id, items, totals; uses EMAIL_FROM; failures retried via queue.

As a new user, I want to verify my email so my account is trusted.

Acceptance criteria:
- Tokenized link emailed on registration (email_verification_tokens).
- Verifying sets is_email_verified=true and used_at; expired/used tokens rejected.

As a user, I want to reset a forgotten password securely.

Acceptance criteria:
- Tokenized reset link emailed (password_reset_tokens).
- New password set; token single-use and expiring.

As a customer, I want to manage my addresses in the UI.

Acceptance criteria:
- List/add/edit/delete addresses; set default (one default enforced).

As an admin, I want to create/manage discount codes (percent/fixed, min order, usage limits, expiry).

Acceptance criteria:
- CRUD on discount_codes; validation of type/value/limits/expiry.

Summary: C2: Apply discount code at checkout
Description:
As a customer, I want to apply a discount code at checkout and see the adjusted total.

Acceptance criteria:
- Validates active/expiry/min-order/usage; updates discount_amount and used_count; recomputes PaymentIntent.

Summary: D1: Record carrier & tracking on shipment
Description:
As an admin, I want to record carrier + tracking number when shipping.

Acceptance criteria:
- Creates order_shipments row on ship; sets order status=shipped; captures estimated delivery.

As a customer, I want to see shipment status and tracking on my order.

Acceptance criteria:
- Order detail shows carrier, tracking number, estimated/actual delivery.

As the business, I want a shipping-cost model (flat/threshold/weight) applied at checkout.

Acceptance criteria:
- Configurable rule; cost added to order total and PaymentIntent.

Summary: E1: Image upload pipeline to managed storage
Description:
As an admin, I want to upload product/variant images to managed storage.

Acceptance criteria:
- Storage backend selected (S3-compatible/Cloudinary); upload endpoint; URLs stored in variant images[]; validation of type/size.

As an admin, I want to manage homepage banners (schedule, position, link).

Acceptance criteria:
- CRUD on banners; public endpoint returns active scheduled banners ordered by position.

As an admin, I want to tag products/articles so the storefront offers tag-based discovery.

Acceptance criteria:
- Manage tags; associate via product_tags/article_tags; public tag filtering.

Summary: F1: Reviews on product detail page
Description:
As a customer, I want to see ratings/reviews on product pages.

Acceptance criteria:
- PDP shows aggregate rating and review list; submit review when eligible.

As the business, I want reviews marked verified purchase so reviews are trustworthy.

Acceptance criteria:
- is_verified_purchase set when reviewer has a delivered order for the product.

As an admin, I want to moderate/hide reviews.

Acceptance criteria:
- Admin can hide/unhide or delete a review; hidden reviews excluded from public view.

As a customer, I want a wishlist page in the UI.

Acceptance criteria:
- View/add/remove wishlist items; move item to cart.

As a customer, I want a read-only chatbot answering product/policy/order-status questions.

Acceptance criteria:
- POST /api/chat streams responses; read-only context (catalogue/policies/FAQ); prompt caching on system prompt; cannot mutate data; persists to chat tables.

As an admin, I want an AI assistant that performs store actions via tool-use with confirmation.

Acceptance criteria:
- POST /api/admin/assistant behind adminProtect; tools map to internal services; destructive actions require confirmation; actions audited.

As the business, I want chat history persisted so we can review and improve.

Acceptance criteria:
- chat_sessions/chat_messages populated including tool_calls JSONB.

As an admin, I want a dashboard with revenue, orders, top products, and conversion.

Acceptance criteria:
- Dashboard shows KPIs over selectable date ranges from order data.

As a super admin, I want to manage admin users and roles.

Acceptance criteria:
- CRUD admin_users; assign role; super_admin-only.

As a super admin, I want to manage site settings (key/value).

Acceptance criteria:
- Read/update site_settings via admin UI.

Summary: H4: Audit log of admin & AI actions
Description:
As the business, I want an audit log of admin actions (incl. AI) for accountability.

Acceptance criteria:
- New audit table records actor/action/target/timestamp; AI tool actions logged.

As an admin, I want role-based access enforced per action so editors can't perform admin-only operations.

Acceptance criteria:
- requireRole guard composed after adminProtect; editor restricted to content.

As the team, I want automated tests starting with order/payment/webhook coverage.

Acceptance criteria:
- Vitest (backend) + React Testing Library (frontend) set up; first tests cover order.service and Stripe webhook; no Jest.

As the business, I want a security baseline before launch.

Acceptance criteria:
- CORS restricted to known origins; rate limiting on auth/chat; Express sessions moved to Redis.

As the team, I want logging, error tracking, and metrics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Structured logging; error tracking (e.g., Sentry); basic metrics.

As the team, I want a single source of truth for schema.

Acceptance criteria:
- Disable sequelize.sync() outside dev; remove stale config.json and legacy models/index.js; migrations tracked.

As the team, I want CI/CD and environment config for staging/prod.

Acceptance criteria:
- Pipeline runs tests/lint/build; deploys to staging; prod config separated.
